title: Fever of unknown origin
definition: Body temperature elevation above normal pyrexial range without established etiology.

title: Hyperpyrexia, unspecified
definition: Extreme fever elevation above 41 degrees Celsius.

title: Fever with rigors and chills
definition: Acute febrile state characterized by violent shivering and sensation of cold.

title: Low-grade persistent pyrexia
definition: Sustained mild elevation of body temperature.

title: Typhoid fever
definition: Systemic infection caused by Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi.

title: Cough
definition: Sudden explosive expiration providing protective respiratory reflex.

title: Dry cough
definition: Non-productive cough without mucus secretion.

title: Acute bronchitis cough
definition: Cough associated with acute bronchial tube inflammation.

title: Productive phlegm cough
definition: Cough characterized by expectoration of purulent or mucoid sputum.

title: Dyspnea
definition: Subjective experience of breathing discomfort and shortness of breath.

title: Asthma
definition: Chronic inflammatory respiratory disease of airways with paroxysmal bronchospasm.

title: Severe acute asthma distress
definition: Acute exacerbation of asthma causing severe respiratory fatigue.

title: Gastro-esophageal reflux disease
definition: Condition developing when reflux of stomach contents causes troublesome symptoms.

title: Diarrhea
definition: Passage of three or more loose or liquid stools per day.

title: Shigellosis dysentery
definition: Intestinal infection caused by Shigella bacteria resulting in bloody diarrhea.

title: Irritable bowel syndrome
definition: Functional bowel disorder characterized by abdominal pain and altered bowel habits.

title: Dyspepsia
definition: Symptom complex of upper abdominal discomfort, bloating, and early satiety.

title: Nausea and vomiting
definition: Unpleasant sensation of urge to vomit and forceful gastric emesis.

title: Hemorrhoids
definition: Symptomatic enlargement and distal displacement of normal anal cushions.

title: Hepatic failure and jaundice
definition: Hyperbilirubinemia leading to yellow discoloration of skin and sclera.

title: Diabetes mellitus
definition: Metabolic disorder characterized by chronic hyperglycemia.

title: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
definition: Diabetes due to progressive loss of adequate beta-cell insulin secretion on background of insulin resistance.

title: Dysuria
definition: Pain, burning, or discomfort during urination.

title: Retention of urine
definition: Inability to completely empty the bladder.

title: Urolithiasis
definition: Formation of urinary calculi anywhere in urinary tract.

title: Osteoarthritis of hip or knee
definition: Degenerative joint disease involving cartilage breakdown.

title: Rheumatoid arthritis
definition: Chronic systemic inflammatory autoimmune disease primarily affecting synovial joints.

title: Gout
definition: Inflammatory arthritis caused by deposition of monosodium urate monohydrate crystals in joints.

title: Sciatica
definition: Neuropathic pain extending along course of sciatic nerve.

title: Low back pain
definition: Pain, muscle tension, or stiffness localized below costal margin and above inferior gluteal folds.

title: Cervical spondylosis
definition: Age-related wear and tear affecting spinal disks in neck.

title: Adhesive capsulitis of shoulder
definition: Frozen shoulder causing painful restriction of glenohumeral joint motion.

title: Dermatitis and eczema
definition: Inflammatory skin condition characterized by erythema, pruritus, and exudation.

title: Atopic eczema
definition: Chronic pruritus skin disease with lichenification and dryness.

title: Psoriasis
definition: Chronic autoimmune papulosquamous skin disorder.

title: Vitiligo
definition: Acquired skin depigmentation disorder resulting from loss of melanocytes.

title: Dermatophytosis ringworm
definition: Fungal infection of keratinized tissues by dermatophytes.

title: Acne vulgaris
definition: Chronic inflammatory disease of pilosebaceous units.

title: Ischemic heart disease
definition: Heart condition caused by reduced blood flow to myocardium.

title: Epistaxis and hemorrhage
definition: Active acute bleeding from nasal passage or mucosal membrane.

title: Iron deficiency anemia
definition: Anemia secondary to inadequate systemic iron stores.
chapter: 03 Diseases of the blood or blood-forming organs

title: Edema, unspecified
definition: Excess fluid accumulation in interstitial tissues.

title: Schizophrenia or primary psychotic disorder
definition: Severe mental disorder with persistent delusions and hallucinations.

title: Epilepsy
definition: Brain disorder characterized by enduring predisposition to generate epileptic seizures.

title: Insomnia disorder
definition: Persistent difficulty with sleep initiation, duration, or quality.

title: Generalized anxiety disorder
definition: Excessive worry and persistent anxiety symptoms.

title: Headache
definition: Pain in head, scalp, or neck region.

title: Migraine
definition: Recurrent paroxysmal headache disorder with sensory and autonomic features.

title: Acute sinusitis
definition: Acute inflammation of paranasal sinus mucosa.

title: Conjunctivitis
definition: Inflammation of conjunctiva of eye.

title: Senile cataract
definition: Age-related opacification of ocular crystalline lens.
